If you like being at the intersection of deep tech and real-world impact, you’ll feel right at home.

 - Design and build full-stack systems that integrate frontend and backend seamlessly

 - Develop scalable APIs and backend services in TypeScript, Kotlin, and Go

 - Deploy and operate services in AWS and other cloud providers

 - Own problems end-to-end—from design through deployment to production support

 - Navigate ambiguity and help define how we build as much as what we build

WHO YOU ARE

 - Experience building and operating full-stack systems

 - Proficiency with TypeScript

 - Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST or GraphQL)

 - Strong backend development experience (Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or similar languages)

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with incomplete information

 - A thoughtful communicator who values clarity and simplicity

 - Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment




BONUS IF YOU HAVE

 - Familiarity with AWS or similar cloud platforms

 - Comfort working with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform or CDK)

 - Comfortable prototyping quickly in React/TypeScript and turning ideas into working features fast
